Placing a Common Mushroom in a [[Seed Maker]] will generate 1-3 [[Fall Seeds]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Robin,Demetrius,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Kent,Marnie,Gus,Sandy |dislike=Maru,Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Haley,Jas,Leo,Vincent,Jodi,Sam,Shane,Elliott,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus |like=Linus,Leah,Harvey }} ==Bundles== Common Mushroom is used in the {{Bundle|Fall Foraging||y}}. ==Recipes== ===Cooking=== {{Recipes|Header}} {{:Fried Mushroom|RecipeRow}} {{:Stir Fry|RecipeRow}} {{:Tom Kha Soup|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|Footer}} ===Crafting=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source !Sell Price |- |[[File:Fall Seeds.png|center|link=]] |[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (Fa)]] ||{{Description|Fall Seeds}}
''(Produces 10 Fall Seeds per craft)'' |{{Name|Blackberry|1}}{{Name|Common Mushroom|1}}{{Name|Hazelnut|1}}{{Name|Wild Plum|1}} |class="no-wrap"|[[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Foraging]] Level 6 |{{Price|45}} |} ==Tailoring== Common Mushroom is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[File:Shirt074.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. This shirt is very likely a reference to the [[wikipedia:Super Mario|Super Mario]] game series, where the titular character [[wikipedia:Mario|Mario]] commonly eats mushrooms. ==Quests== *The Common Mushroom may be randomly requested in [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|120}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. *2-3 Common Mushrooms may be requested by [[Bullhead]], [[Largemouth Bass]], or [[Woodskip]] in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]]. ==Trivia== *Common Mushrooms are the only fall forageable that can be directly put into the [[Seed Maker]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].
